# Frame

Keeps related nodes visually grouped.

`lfs.frame` · Layout

## How to use

Drop nodes into the frame. Moving the frame moves its members.\
Drag a member outside the frame to remove it.

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Label | `label` | string | Frame | — | Frame heading. |
| Colour | `colour` | string | neutral | — | Theme colour preset or RGB value. |
| Note | `note` | string |  | — | Optional text shown under the heading. |
